engineApi.name: openSheet
engineApi.description: null or sheet id; replaces scanning .hidden on #panel-*; drives sheet visibility and tab .active (Weather/Tides/More only)

engineApi.name: toggleSheet(id) / closeSheets()
engineApi.description: Same semantics as togglePanel/closePanels: opening one closes the rest; re-clamps height

engineApi.name: sheetOpened
engineApi.description: Fired with id when a sheet opens so modules run their on-open loaders

engineApi.name: toast(msg) / toastState
engineApi.description: Show a 3s toast; last call wins

engineApi.name: boot
engineApi.description: {status, done} for the splash

engineApi.name: online
engineApi.description: navigator.onLine mirror; OFFLINE badge, assistant status

engineApi.name: tileBusy
engineApi.description: true while any tracked tile layer is loading

engineApi.name: lume / setLume(l)
engineApi.description: Set <html data-lume> AND re-apply the base filter (fixing the invalid 'url(#lut-night) none' composition)

engineApi.name: reliefPlain / setReliefPlain(b)
